from pathlib import Path
import sys, json, hashlib, dataclasses, enum, time, os, gzip
from fractions import Fraction
root=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(); out=Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
sys.path[:0]=[str(root/'artifacts/numeric_repr'),str(root/'kernel/src'),str(root/'artifacts/sympy_off_hot_path')]
import gate
gate.init_worker()
from cftuv_envelope.reference import boundary, strip, native_exact as nx, planar_types as pt
from cftuv_envelope.materialize.clip_memo import kernel_code_identity
from cftuv_envelope.backend import use_backend, KernelBackendV1
backend_scope=use_backend(KernelBackendV1.PYTHON); backend_scope.__enter__()
trace={}; aliases={}
def value(text):
    n=nx.native_of_text(text)
    if not n.terms: return ['Q',0,1]
    if len(n.terms)==1:
        r,c=n.terms[0]
        if r==1:return ['Q',c.numerator,c.denominator]
        square=c*c*r
        return ['SQ',-1 if c<0 else 1,square.numerator,square.denominator]
    return ['multi',str(n.terms)]
def digest(obj):return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(obj,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
def install(module):
    original=module.stable_id
    def observed(*args):
        result=original(*args)
        if args[0] in ('boundary-contact','envelope-instance'):
            canonical=[str(item) for item in args[:-1]]+[value(args[-1])]
            key=digest(canonical)
            aliases[result]='VALUE-ID:'+key
            trace[key]={'kind':args[0],'args':[str(item) for item in args[:-1]],'alpha_text':args[-1],'alpha_value':canonical[-1],'id':result}
        return result
    module.stable_id=observed
install(boundary); install(strip)
def normal(obj):
    if obj is None or isinstance(obj,(bool,int,float)):return obj
    if isinstance(obj,str):return aliases.get(obj,obj)
    if isinstance(obj,Fraction):return ['Q',obj.numerator,obj.denominator]
    if isinstance(obj,enum.Enum):return [type(obj).__name__,obj.name]
    if isinstance(obj,pt.ExactScalar):return ['ExactScalar',value(obj.expression)]
    if type(obj).__name__=='ExactWorkBudgetV1':return 'BUDGET'
    if dataclasses.is_dataclass(obj):return [type(obj).__name__,{f.name:normal(getattr(obj,f.name)) for f in dataclasses.fields(obj)}]
    if isinstance(obj,dict):return sorted([[normal(k),normal(v)] for k,v in obj.items()],key=repr)
    if isinstance(obj,(set,frozenset)):return sorted((normal(v) for v in obj),key=repr)
    if isinstance(obj,(list,tuple)):return [normal(v) for v in obj]
    return [type(obj).__name__,repr(obj)]
record={'root':str(root),'python':sys.version,'argv':sys.argv,'hash_seed':os.environ.get('PYTHONHASHSEED'),'kernel_code_identity':kernel_code_identity(),'kernel_backend':'PYTHON','rows':[]}
original_answer=gate._answer_of
def answer(prepared,domain):
    result=original_answer(prepared,domain)
    payload=(domain.regions,domain.faces,domain.segments)
    result['fp_geometry_value_and_alpha_identity']=digest(normal(payload))
    return result
gate._answer_of=answer
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def save():out.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
if len(sys.argv)<4:
    for density in (1,2,4):
        for patch_id in sorted(gate.pool_sweep._CTX['patch_ids']):
            trace.clear();aliases.clear()
            row=gate.compute_row(patch_id,density)
            row['source']='building';row['identity_trace']=dict(trace)
            record['rows'].append(row)
            save()
        print('completed building',density,len(record['rows']),flush=True)
elif sys.argv[3]=='extras':
    import scene_exports
    from cftuv_envelope.reference import symbolic_backend as sb
    from run_domain import bundle_from_field_snapshot, snapshot_and_request, timed_queue
    from snapshot_bmesh import load_snapshot, selected_edge_ids
    import env
    for name in scene_exports.SNAPSHOTS:
        path=env.SNAPSHOTS/f'{name}.json'
        selected=frozenset(selected_edge_ids(load_snapshot(path)))
        _,_,bundle=bundle_from_field_snapshot(path)
        for density in (1,2,4):
            for patch_id,domain_id,snapshot,request in snapshot_and_request(bundle,selected,density=density):
                trace.clear();aliases.clear();gate._reset_backend_counts()
                prepared,domain,_=timed_queue(patch_id,domain_id,snapshot,request)
                record['rows'].append({'source':name,'patch_id':patch_id,'density':density,'answer':answer(prepared,domain),'identity_trace':dict(trace),'price':dict(domain.coverage_work)})
                save()
        print('completed scene',name,len(record['rows']),flush=True)
print('FINISHED',len(record['rows']),flush=True)
